verse.verse_2: Who hath gathered wealth (of this world) and arranged it.
verse.verse_3: He thinketh that his wealth will render him immortal.
verse.verse_4: Nay, but verily he will be flung to the Consuming One.
verse.verse_5: Ah, what will convey unto thee what the Consuming One is!
verse.verse_6: (It is) the fire of Allah, kindled,
verse.verse_7: Which leapeth up over the hearts (of men).
verse.verse_8: Lo! it is closed in on them
